parsed.name: Excel兼容CSV数据导出器
parsed.description: 这是一个用于实验室数据记录的软件导出组件，可将测量结果按表格形式追加并写入Excel可打开的CSV文件，便于实验数据归档、共享和离线分析。
parsed.description_en: This is a software export component for laboratory data logging. It appends measurement results in tabular form and writes them to Excel-compatible CSV files for archiving, sharing, and offline analysis.

actions.description: 追加一组带名称的数据到待写入的CSV数据中。
actions.description_en: Append a named set of data to the pending CSV dataset.

actions.description: 将当前缓存的数据写入CSV文件。
actions.description_en: Write the currently buffered data to the CSV file.
